title: The Wright Brothers' First Flight Was Shorter Than a Jumbo Jet's Wing

scenes.text: The first airplane flight was shorter than a jumbo jet's wingspan.
On December seventeenth, 1903, the Wright Flyer took off.
The first flight lasted twelve seconds and covered a hundred and twenty feet.
A Boeing seven forty-seven's wings stretch wider than that.
They flew three more times that day.
The longest covered eight hundred and fifty-two feet in fifty-nine seconds.
From twelve seconds to a jet that crosses oceans.

description:
The first airplane flight was shorter than a jumbo jet's wingspan.
On December 17, 1903, the Wright Flyer flew 120 feet in 12 seconds. Its longest flight that day covered 852 feet in 59 seconds.
Would you have bought a ticket?
first_comment: Bonus: that day's best flight lasted just under a minute. What was the first thing you would do in the air?
